entries.description: The number spelled out. format names the language (L=ru_RU, or Л=uk); a code's region suffix is ignored. params declines a subject: one,few,many,gender and, after those, the fractional subject and how many digits it keeps (рубль,рубля,рублей,м,копейка,копейки,копеек,ж,2). Russian and Ukrainian use the last two digits (11 is many, 21 is one, 2 is few); English uses one only for 1. The first letter is capital. A negative number is prefixed with minus.
entries.parameters: number — the amount. format — L=language, optional. params — one,few,many,gender[,fracOne,fracFew,fracMany,fracGender,digits], optional.
